text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
-Some passengers panicked during the evacuation from the ferry Stena Saga at the weekend. The ferry, en route to Denmark, had to turn back to Oslo following a bomb threat. No bomb was found, however.

-Norway's BSK managed only a 23-23 draw against Borussia Dortmund and were ejected from the European women's handball cup while the Germans made it to the quarterfinals. Players blamed each other for the defeat.
- While dozens of the world's telecommunication companies are preparing a partial privatisation, Norway's Telenor will remain state-owned.
-Kjell Inge Roekke's RGI and Norway Seafoods are about to take over Frionor frozen fish company from Orkla.
-Schibsted Nett and the Postal authority have signed an agreement under which customers will be able to go shopping via Internet nationwide.
